digest.component_or_area: reconciler Jira-family vendor-adapter seam / ADR 0035 amendment
propositions: Write ADR 0055 amending ADR 0035 to record the jira_family sub-seam, its two parameterizing contracts, the shared-jira provenance decision, the pycontribs/jira extra-gated dependency, and the March 2029 DC read-only horizon that makes the DC adapter a time-boxed investment.

Record the port-incompleteness finding as a property of the seam: TicketTransport declares six members while the core reaches for twenty-one distinct transport members (twelve absent from the DC transport), causing a live DC crash on set_entity_property while isinstance checks, the contract suite, and 1636 unit tests all passed.
State that ADR 0035's claim that the contract suite certifies a backend is conditional on the port being complete and typed, since an unannotated transport parameter hides the gap from mypy.
Present RemoteRef.instance as intended design with a named tracked gap, not existing reality, because it is never constructed in production code (only in two test helpers).

Correct all stale ADR 0035 statements that the first real second backend is out of scope, appearing in the layout-diagram comment, prose, Decision item 6, and a fourth site in Consequences, because Jira Data Center landed ahead of the GitHub adapter epic be74.

Prove the documented DC setup commands run against the linux/amd64-only J5 harness via a test that parses the config block out of user-guide.md, requires a no_write dry-run envelope, and verifies JIRA_PAT is env-only and the jira-datacenter extra exists.
